final: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS all_avg FROM eq), grp AS (SELECT AVG(eq.avg_hum) AS grp_avg FROM eq, overall WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.all_avg) SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, eq.avg_hum - overall.all_avg AS exceed_overall, eq.avg_hum - grp.grp_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM eq, overall, grp WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.all_avg AND overall.all_avg IS NOT NULL AND grp.grp_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC LIMIT 10
